ashok: noticed a big drop in prefix-cache hit-rate after last night's runtime compile (attn-compiler v2 + quant profile q4_0). hit-rate fell from ~86% to ~51% on top chat endpoints.
maria: yikes. which endpoints? any patterns (seq len, model, hosted vs dedicated)?
ashok: mostly hosted/chat endpoints for model=mistral-mix-8x (we switched to q4_0 + attn-compiler v2 to squeeze latency). median prompt len ~480, lots of prefix reuse. p95 latency up ~140ms which matches extra token cost from cache misses.
kevin: can you share a few kvcache traces and computed keys? want to see if it's key mismatch vs eviction churn.
ashok: sample kvcache lines from the window:

```
[kvcache] route=chat-global model=mistral-mix-8x quant=q4_0 compiler=attn-c-v2 computed_key=sha1:1e7c... -> lookup MISS
[kvcache] key_components=[model:mistral-mix-8x, model_ver:2026-02, prefix_hash:bb12c, seq:480, compiler_variant:attn_c_v2]
[kvcache] route=chat-global model=mistral-mix-8x quant=q3_1 compiler=attn-c-v1 computed_key=sha1:1e7c... -> lookup HIT
```

ashok: same payload hash used with v1/q3_1, but with v2/q4 we see different computed components ordering. suspect key schema changed (we began inserting compiler_variant before prefix_hash).
liz: iirc a safety change added compiler_variant into key to avoid sharing caches across kernel variants. that should be okay but we didn't run a coordinated prewarm or add a lookup-compatibility shim.
maria: did the new compiler introduce small prefix canonicalization changes? whitespace/token boundary tweaks can change prefix_hash and cause misses.
ashok: yes, attn-c-v2 added a micro normalization step (collapse NNBSP sequences) to match packed attention kernels. that touched ~36% of active prefixes. combined with key-schema reorder, this caused a large fraction of traffic to miss.
kevin: so root cause: two independent changes (key composition order + normalization) + quant differences -> effectively cold cache for many sessions. that matches the latency spike.
ashok: metrics from a 20m post-deploy window: hit-rate 51%, token cost +22%, p99 latency +175ms. after rolling back compiler to attn-c-v1, hit-rate returned to ~85% in ~12m.

infra-bot: rollback initiated by @ashok  rb-2026-03-17-09

liz: let's not push attn-c-v2 to prod again until we have a migration strategy. immediate mitigations to consider: 
- adopt a stable key schema with explicit ordering and a key-schema version tag
- implement a compatibility lookup that tries legacy ordering on miss for a grace window
- decouple prefix canonicalization from kernel rollout (enable new normalization via config flag first)
- prewarm top-n prefixes per route asynchronously after any key/schema change

maria: lookup-both sounds like a fast hotfix. if miss -> recompute alt key using legacy order and check store.

kevin: quick sketch (pseudo):

```
# canonical stable order: model|model_ver|quant|compiler|prefix_hash
def build_key(parts, order=STABLE_ORDER):
    return '|'.join([parts[k] for k in order])

key = build_key(parts, order=STABLE_ORDER)
value = store.get(key)
if not value:
    alt_key = build_key(parts, order=LEGACY_ORDER)
    value = store.get(alt_key)
    if value:
        metrics.count('compat_hit')
        return value
    else:
        return MISS
```

ashok: deployed compat-lookup to staging and ran a replayer: compat hits recovered ~30% of miss volume in replay. then we ran a prewarm job that pushed top prefixes and recovered another ~18% over 8 minutes. combined that got hit-rate close to the baseline in staging.
liz: long-term: 1) add key-schema versioning baked into the key, 2) run differential instrumentation on prefix normalization on canary vs baseline before flipping, 3) update rollout playbook: (a) land normalization behind a config flag off by default, (b) run prewarm, (c) enable compat-lookup + flip flag, (d) retire compat after retention window.

devex-bot: RFC created: /docs/rfcs/prefix-key-versioning.md

maria: action items:
- infra: keep attn-c-v1 in prod until we validate migration path (liz + infra team)
- eng-runtime: merge compat-lookup hotfix and enable on prod (kevin + ashok)
- perf: run 24h synthetic replay of v2+q4 with prewarm heuristics to model cost deltas (maria)
- ops: draft customer-facing note for any SLA impacts and prepare postmortem if needed (ops-team)

ashok: i'll upload perf dashboards and the replay script to #eng-runtime after I scrub logs. :eyes:
kevin: opening compat-lookup PR now.
liz: adding a rollout-note to the playbook so we don't change canonicalization and key ordering together again. :memo:

ashok: closing the loop  rollback successful, monitoring green. will coordinate a staged re-deploy next week with prewarm + compatibility checks. :thumbsup:
